ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 1. Affiliate as a real business
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
You earn commission promoting products you did not build. Trust is the product. Promote junk once and the audience leaves.

Action: write your ethical promotion rule.

Apply "Affiliate as a real business" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 2. Niche and audience fit
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Pick problems you understand. Match offers to credibility.

Action: define niche in one sentence.

Apply "Niche and audience fit" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 3. Choosing products ethically
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Use what you respect. Disclose relationships. Skip miracle income claims.

Action: shortlist two offers max.

Apply "Choosing products ethically" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 4. Traffic sources
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Content, video, newsletter, communities. Own an email list when you can.

Action: pick one primary traffic source.

Apply "Traffic sources" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 5. Content that converts
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Help first, recommend second. Comparisons and honest limits convert better than hype.

Action: outline one helpful article or video.

Apply "Content that converts" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 6. Honest promotion
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Say who it is for and who should skip. Long-term income beats one shady spike.

Action: write a disclosure line you will always use.

Apply "Honest promotion" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 7. Tracking commissions
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Use program dashboards. Note which content drives sales.

Action: weekly commission review reminder.

Apply "Tracking commissions" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 8. Email list ownership
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Algorithms change. Lists compound. Give useful free value to grow the list.

Action: create a simple lead magnet idea.

Apply "Email list ownership" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 9. Compliance and reputation
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
No fake scarcity, no guaranteed income, no medical miracles.

Action: read the affiliate program rules for your offer.

Apply "Compliance and reputation" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 10. Diversifying offers
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Two to five strong offers beat twenty random links.

Action: cut weak links from your bio.

Apply "Diversifying offers" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 11. Scaling what works
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Double down on content types that sell. Cut the rest.

Action: rank content by sales last 30 days.

Apply "Scaling what works" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-affiliate-marketing.title: 12. 30-day launch plan
ebook-affiliate-marketing.body:
Week 1 niche+program, week 2 three assets, week 3 promote, week 4 review conversions.

Action: calendar the four weeks.

Apply "30-day launch plan" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 1. AI as intern not CEO
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Use AI to draft, summarise, and brainstorm. You still decide quality, pricing, and promises. Never treat fluent text as verified truth.

Action: label AI output as draft in your workflow.

Apply "AI as intern not CEO" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 2. High-ROI use cases
ebook-ai-sme.body:
WhatsApp reply drafts, product descriptions, content ideas, SOP first drafts, meeting summaries, turning rough notes into client updates.

Action: pick one use case to master for 14 days.

Apply "High-ROI use cases" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 3. Prompt patterns that work
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Give role, context, constraints, format. Example: polite salon receptionist in Lagos, three Saturday slot replies under Naira X, warm and short.

Action: write three prompt patterns for your business.

Apply "Prompt patterns that work" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 4. Customer replies with AI
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Draft from a private FAQ. Do not invent policies. Edit for local prices and tone before send.

Action: build a 10-question FAQ for AI-assisted replies.

Apply "Customer replies with AI" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 5. Content drafts without sounding fake
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Always add a human line only you would know. Edit out generic fluff and false claims.

Action: generate then rewrite one caption with your voice.

Apply "Content drafts without sounding fake" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 6. SOPs and operations
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Turn tribal knowledge into steps: opening, closing, refunds, delivery. AI drafts; you verify once; staff follow.

Action: document one SOP with AI assistance then verify.

Apply "SOPs and operations" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 7. Research and planning
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Extract from your documents first, then ask for options. Separate facts from recommendations.

Action: run a plan prompt on your real constraints.

Apply "Research and planning" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 8. Risks and data privacy
ebook-ai-sme.body:
No legal/medical advice as expert. No fake reviews. Protect API keys and customer data.

Action: write three AI don't rules for your team.

Apply "Risks and data privacy" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 9. Tool stack for SMEs
ebook-ai-sme.body:
One chat tool, one image tool if needed, shared prompt notes. Avoid paying for five overlapping subscriptions.

Action: cancel or pause one unused AI subscription.

Apply "Tool stack for SMEs" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 10. Team adoption
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Train with real examples from your business. Measure hours saved and errors made.

Action: run a 30-minute team demo on one workflow.

Apply "Team adoption" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 11. Measuring time saved
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Before/after time on replies, captions, or reports. Keep what works; drop the rest.

Action: time one task this week with and without AI.

Apply "Measuring time saved" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.

ebook-ai-sme.title: 12. 30-day AI adoption plan
ebook-ai-sme.body:
Week 1 replies/captions, week 2 SOPs, week 3 product copy, week 4 measure and standardise prompts.

Action: put the four weeks on a calendar.

Apply "30-day AI adoption plan" this week: schedule one concrete action and complete it before the weekend.
